decisions.reason: As a recently launched multi-model handle family in the firm's core door-hardware business that remained on the website through 2024, management is likely to justify its investment and give it more time rather than withdraw it quickly.

Its dedicated page in 2024 signals a visible public commitment and strategic relevance to the firm's human-centered system offering, which makes management inclined to persist unless results clearly collapse.

Although it has less visible acclaim than some other launches, it is still a core-category door lever line that stayed on the website in 2024, so sunk development and range-coordination costs favor continuation.

This collection has the strongest public commitment and external validation through dedicated presentation and major design awards, so an escalation-of-commitment logic makes withdrawal within a year very unlikely.
